parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the instance to be associated with the HAVIP. Valid values:

*   EnsInstance (default): ENS instance
*   NetworkInterface: elastic network interface (ENI)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens associate-ha-vip --ha-vip-id havip-5p14t0000 --instance-id i-50c40000 --instance-type EnsInstance --region cn-hangzhou
